texts: My brother wears a bright tilak every morning but cheats his customers, and I want a doha saying that honest living matters more than a mark on the forehead.
hey can u write a doha about how a spotless forehead mark means nothing if you lie all day
honesty, forehead mark
O pilgrim, the saffron dot upon your brow fades by dusk, yet a word spoken true glows forever within the heart.

Please write a Kabir-style couplet for a man who paints a vermilion mark on his forehead every dawn but tells small lies to everyone around him, reminding him that honest speech is the greatest penance of all.
Pure is the vow of the honest voice, and the false word darkens even the brightest spirit.
I want a doha for my teenage daughter who keeps hiding small things from us out of fear; remind her that telling the plain truth is worth more than any penance or sacrifice she could perform.
I got caught lying to my boss about a missed deadline and felt awful afterwards; something for people who want to start living honestly again.
need a doha on why lying is the worst sin, short n simple pls
honest living always
pls write a doha where a liar is compared to a snake hiding in the grass, quick one
My cousin's lies keep coiling around the whole family until nobody trusts anyone, and I'd love a doha about how a snake's venom is nothing next to a lie.
A young clerk in my office hides every mistake behind sweet words; give me a doha telling him that a lie is like a snake that finally bites its own keeper, while plain honesty keeps one safe.
snake of lies
The snake of falsehood sheds its skin each season, yet its poison stays; only the one who speaks plainly sleeps without fear.
can u make a doha on honest living using a spinning wheel, like spinning only honest words
Round and round the spinning wheel hums its song; spin only true words from your heart, for a lie never survives the night.
spinning wheel, honesty
My grandmother used to turn her spinning wheel every evening and say she never told a lie in her whole life; I want a doha in her honor.
Write a couplet about a village woman who works her spinning wheel all day and speaks only what is real, showing that an honest life of simple work needs no other penance or pilgrimage to be holy.
give me a short doha abt always telling the truth even when its hard
Like dawn that cannot be hidden, an honest word rises on its own while the false one drifts away unseen.
My friend asked whether he should confess a mistake at work that nobody has noticed yet, and I want a doha that tells him a clean confession is the greatest penance and a lie the heaviest sin.
I told my parents I was studying but went out with friends, and the guilt keeps eating me up inside.
no sin like lying
Please compose a doha about a man who thinks his small lie is as harmless as a tiny fly, until it buzzes around him and wrecks his good name; honest speech alone keeps a person peaceful.
lying, tiny fly
doha on how even a tiny lie buzzes around u like a fly forever lol
I told a tiny lie to my sister last week, and it keeps buzzing in my head like a fly, and now I have to tell another to cover it.
A small untruth is a fly on the honey of your name; brush it off today, or watch it gather a swarm.
make a doha: honest speech is like a cuckoo's song and an honest heart is like a lotus, thanks
lotus, cuckoo, honesty
The cuckoo sings no lie in the mango grove, the lotus rises unstained from the pond; so too the soul that speaks true.
Our neighbor is gentle, never exaggerates, and people love hearing her voice like a cuckoo in spring while her character stays unsoiled like a lotus; a doha for her?
I need a doha for a school assembly about a girl who always speaks honestly: her sweet voice is like a cuckoo, and her pure heart stays unstained like a lotus in a muddy pond.

Write me a doha for a politician who promises everything and delivers nothing, reminding him that the saint's way is simple honest living where words and deeds match, and no other austerity is needed.
short doha on honesty being the best austerity pls
honest living, clean conscience
O friend, the oath of honest speech needs no pilgrimage; walk in it and the soul is already bathed in grace.
At my daughter's wedding my uncle owned up to an old lie in front of everyone, and the relief on his face was something; I'd like a doha for that moment.
My father always said a man who lies is like someone setting fire to the tree he sits under, and I'd like that thought in a doha.
doha pls: a lie is fire and a truthful man is a shady tree
tree, fire, honesty
Compose a doha that says an honest person gives shelter to everyone like a shady tree, while a liar carries a fire that burns his own branches and all the people who trusted him in the end.
Under the tree of honest speech the weary rest; the liar's word is a fire that devours its own roots.
Truth is the ocean without a shore, and the touchstone on which every sacred claim is tested; the liar drowns in shallow puddles.
Our auditors went through my partner's accounts line by line, and his honest dealings passed every check like a test on a touchstone; the ocean of worry just calmed.
Write a doha saying honest living is as deep as the ocean and as unforgiving as a touchstone, because every word we speak is tested against it, and only the plain spoken person passes without fear.
ocean, touchstone, honesty
yo can u write a doha w ocean + touchstone for being honest all the time
A poor man sleeps soundly under a plain cloth sheet because his conscience is clear, while the liar tosses on his bed as if burning in fire; please write this as a doha about honest living.
cloth sheet, fire, honesty
Spread the plain cloth sheet of honest speech; the fire of falsehood cannot catch where no lie has been woven.
I've been wrapped in a worn cloth sheet since my business failed, but I refused to cheat anyone to recover, and I sleep peacefully; the fire of regret never reached me.
doha pls, honest man under his plain cloth sheet vs liar in fire of worry
I'd like a doha for my son who is starting his first job and may be tempted to bend the rules; tell him that nothing is higher than honesty, and no sin is greater than falsehood, ever.
write something on being honest even when nobody's watching
The honest soul walks in daylight even at midnight, while the liar stumbles in the dark at noon.
no penance like honesty
My neighbor returned the extra money a cashier gave him by mistake, though he needed every rupee, and I was moved.
Beware the snake in the sweet-voiced word, for it coils in the heart of the liar and strikes at last.
can u write a doha where lies = snake, simple language
snake, liar, honesty
Write me a doha about a man whose lies grew like a snake until it swallowed his friendships, showing that a clean, honest life never needs to fear any bite.
I found out my colleague had been lying for months, and it felt like discovering a snake in the grass; I want something about honest living for him.
doha about how honesty is the real religion
plain speech, pure life
My teacher never raised her voice yet no student dared lie to her, and I want a doha about people whose word is their bond.
Please give me a doha for a village elder who has never once spoken a false word in eighty years, and whose simple life shows that honesty is a greater penance than any ritual or pilgrimage.
The honest heart needs no witness; its word shines at dawn and still shines at dusk, unchanged.
peacock, honest living
doha idea: peacock looks proud but a liar is worse, honesty is real beauty
My cousin spends hours on his looks like a peacock displaying feathers, yet lies to his friends without blinking; I'd like to remind him what real beauty is.
The peacock dances in borrowed colors, but the honest soul is beautiful without a single feather.
Write a doha about how outward glamour, like a peacock's spread feathers, impresses for a moment, but only a truthful life earns lasting respect and brings inner peace to a person's whole being.
I want a doha saying that honest speech is the philosopher's stone that turns an ordinary man into someone priceless, far better than any penance, pilgrimage, or fast could ever make him.
Honest speech is the philosopher's stone: touch a common life with it and it becomes priceless.
doha idea: honesty is like the philosopher's stone, changes everything it touches
philosopher's stone, honesty
After my brother stopped lying and started owning his mistakes, everything in his life changed, as if he had found the philosopher's stone; a doha for him?
doha about a tongue that never lies pls
honest tongue
A tongue that speaks no falsehood is sweeter than nectar, and a lying one is bitter poison however sweet it sounds.
My mother always told me to think before I speak, because my tongue once got me into trouble over a lie I told a friend; maybe a doha on that.
Write a doha for children about keeping their tongue honest: one lie leads to another until the speaker loses everyone's trust, whereas a plain true word brings peace and respect to the whole life.
sandalwood, honest words
Sandalwood stays cool though venom lurks near it; so the honest soul stays pure among deceivers.
In our office everyone gossips and bends facts but my colleague stays calm and clean in her speech, like the fragrance of sandalwood that never changes; doha for her?

Please write a doha that compares an honest person to sandalwood, whose fragrance does not change whether it is cut, rubbed or burned, so the truthful man's word remains the same in every situation he faces.
sandalwood + honesty doha pls, make it simple
Write a doha explaining that a diamond cannot be burned by fire and an honest person cannot be broken by hardship, because the one who lives truthfully has nothing to hide and nothing to fear.
doha: honest man is a diamond, even fire cant harm him
diamond, fire, honesty
Though fire rage around it, the diamond keeps its brilliance; so shines the one who never lied.
Through the worst year of my life, when everyone pressured me to hide facts and bend my statements, I held firm, and I came out stronger like a diamond through fire.
My little nephew confessed that he broke something and then waited nervously, and I told him honesty is always better; need a doha to teach him.
lying, greatest sin
Where honesty lives, the soul is a calm sky; where falsehood lives, a storm that never ends.
could u write a doha about being honest in relationships

Compose a doha for a married couple who have started hiding small things from one another, reminding them that nothing is greater than honest speech, and that lying quietly destroys what love has built.
truth over everything
doha pls honest living is the best way to live
Speak plainly, dear heart; the lie is a long night and the true word is the morning that ends it.
A newly elected village head asked for a doha to guide him; say that speaking honestly and keeping his word is better than any penance or ritual.
I finally told my best friend the real reason I missed her birthday, and it felt like I could breathe again.
ash, honest living
My uncle sits for hours smeared in ash like a holy man but cheats his brothers over land; I want a doha about what real penance is.
Write a doha saying that rubbing ash on the body and sitting in meditation is meaningless if the person lies, because the highest penance is simply to speak and live honestly every single day.
Ash upon the body, a lie upon the lips; only the honest word turns the pilgrim holy.
doha pls: no point covering urself in ash if ur a liar
honesty beats penance
Better than a thousand vows is one clear word spoken without fear.
My grandfather's last advice to me was that a person is worth exactly as much as their word, so please write a doha capturing that idea of living honestly all through life.
I decided to stop exaggerating my achievements in interviews, and it was scary but freeing; a doha for anyone who chooses plain honesty.
write a doha about lying being a sin worse than anything
My manager asked everyone to sign a false report and I refused, though it cost me a promotion; write me a doha that celebrates choosing honesty over comfort and calls lying the worst of sins.
I walked away from a profitable deal today because it needed one small lie.
pls a doha on honesty over profit
honest loss, clean mind
Let the world call you poor; the one who speaks true holds a wealth no ruler can take.
doha on honesty and fair scales pls
scales, honest dealing
Let the scales of your word hang level, O friend, for the Judge weighs every syllable you speak.
My uncle once used rigged scales to earn a little more and was ashamed forever after; I'd like a doha about fair dealing.
Write a doha about a person who keeps his scales honest and his speech honest, showing that true penance is not a ritual but fairness in every dealing with others, big or small.
Write a doha for the day of a funeral: wrapped in his white shroud and carried on a palanquin, a man takes with him only the honesty or the lies he lived by, so speak of living truthfully.
The shroud has no pockets, the palanquin no room for lies; what rides beside you is only the word you kept.
doha about shroud and palanquin and why lying is pointless
shroud, palanquin, honesty
At my uncle's funeral, as he lay in his white shroud on the palanquin, they said he never cheated anyone in his life, and I wished I could live like him.
Honest speech is the only prayer the heart can offer without shame.
I'd like a doha for a young journalist who has to choose between popularity and honest reporting, reminding him that a person who tells the plain facts carries no sin and needs no penance.
need a doha on honesty, kinda emotional pls
honesty, nothing else
I lied to my mother about my exam results for weeks and finally told her last night; she hugged me instead of scolding.
never lie, ever
Please write a doha reminding me that the sin of lying outweighs all virtues, and that a man who keeps his speech clean has already completed the hardest penance there is in this world.
doha about being honest w urself first
Honest words bring peace; falsehood brings only restless nights.
After my father lost his job he still refused to lie on any form, and he says it kept his dignity.
Write a doha about a man who works the oil press from dawn to dusk, earning little, yet who never cheats a customer or tells a lie, proving honest living is the finest penance.
The oil press worker in our village earns very little but nobody has ever heard him lie, and watching him made me want a doha about that.
oil press, honest living
doha pls: honest worker at the oil press
Though the oil press grinds all day, the honest worker's conscience is never crushed.
word is bond
I promised my friend I'd keep his secret and I did, even when it cost me; I'd like a doha for keeping one's word.
write a doha about promises and honesty
A promise kept is a prayer answered; a promise broken, a wound that no apology can close.
Compose a doha for someone who has just discovered that honesty was always the harder way but also the only one that leaves the mind quiet at night and the heart free from fear.
In the court of the heart, no lawyer argues; the verdict on every lie is written in silence.
doha on lying being the worst sin ever pls
My sister asked me to back up her story, but it wasn't quite true, and I said no; now she isn't talking to me.
Write a doha reminding children and elders alike that the greatest penance is not fasting or pilgrimage but speaking only what is real, since a single lie weighs more than a thousand good deeds.
honest living, pure life
door, chakor bird, honesty
Our old neighbor knocks at my door each evening to say honest things I need to hear, as loyal as a chakor bird; I want a doha about him.
Write a doha about how a person who keeps his door open to honesty, unwavering as the chakor bird in its devotion, never has to hide anything from the world or fear who comes knocking.
doha with chakor bird and door about being honest
Open the door to the honest word, as the chakor opens its heart to the sky; no lie can enter there.
A small seed of falsehood grows into a harvest of regret; plant only the honest seed.
I planted one tiny lie in my first week at work, like a seed, and now I'm maintaining a whole overgrown pile of them.
seed of honesty
Please write a doha saying that every lie is a seed that grows into trouble, while one honest word planted in time becomes a shelter for the whole family, which is the greatest penance anyone can do.
doha: lie is a seed that grows into big trouble
Write a doha about how a liar's tongue speaks sweetly but his heart burns in a furnace of fear, whereas the honest man's tongue is simple and his heart is cool, which is the greatest penance.
My friend keeps telling stories to impress people, and I can see how his tongue runs while his mind is in constant torment, like he's burning in a furnace; I want something for him.
The furnace of falsehood heats the heart, but the honest tongue is a cool breeze.
doha pls: furnace of lies, honest tongue stays cool
furnace, tongue, honesty
Write a doha showing that a lie is like a thread you must keep adding to, getting more tangled each day, while honest speech is a single straight line that never needs mending or covering.
I have lied to my family about my job for so long that I'm tangled in a thread of excuses and I can't remember what I told whom.
One lie is a thread, a hundred a tangled skein; the honest soul walks free of every knot.
doha: lies are like a thread that keeps tangling
thread of lies
O mind, wear honesty like the breath you carry; it asks nothing yet holds you alive.
When my son was little he told me something hard about his day and I didn't scold him; I want a doha about why honesty should be welcomed.
honesty, greatest penance
short doha on speaking honestly and living clean pls
Compose a doha that reminds us no ritual, no fast, no pilgrimage can match the penance of honest living, and that the sin of lying outweighs every virtue a person has built over the course of years.
doha with a one-string lute and a touchstone about honesty
A wandering singer plucks his one-string lute and sings only honest songs, and each word is tested like a touchstone by the listeners; write a doha about this honest life lived simply.
one-string lute, touchstone, honesty
A street singer with a one-string lute sang a song about honest dealing in our colony, and every word seemed to pass a touchstone test; I'd like a doha like that.
The one-string lute has but one note, as the honest heart has but one word; the touchstone proves it pure.
honest life, no fear
I was brought up to believe that saying hard things is a form of love, and today I realized it again when I apologized to my brother.
Speak the word as it is, and the world will grow quiet around you.
doha pls: lying is the biggest sin
Write a doha on how a man who tells the truth in every situation sleeps without worry, wakes without fear, and has no need for rituals, because his honest living is itself the highest penance.
doha for my kid abt not lying plz
Please write a doha for the leaders of a village council, reminding them that justice rests on honesty and that no other penance is greater, and no sin is heavier, than the lie told for gain.
My friend admitted he'd been copying my work for a year, and instead of anger I felt respect for his courage.
The honest voice is a quiet dawn that needs no announcement.
pure speech, pure heart
Write a doha saying that honest words are a pearl found only in the deep well of a clean heart, and that no amount of ritual fasting can bring such a treasure to the one who lies.
In the deep well of the heart lies a pearl called honesty; dive in, and leave the false coins behind.
pearl, well, honesty
doha pls: honesty = pearl in a deep well
My grandmother's village well was famed for its depth, and she used to say honesty is like a pearl at its bottom; I want a doha for her memory.
The cuckoo sings only what it knows, the spinning wheel turns only what is real; be like them, O friend, and speak no lie.
doha w cuckoo + spinning wheel about honest speech
My aunt hums like a cuckoo while turning her spinning wheel and has never told a lie; I want a doha that captures her honest, sweet life.
cuckoo, spinning wheel, honesty
Write a doha about a woman who sits at her spinning wheel and sings like a cuckoo, whose every word is as honest as her work, showing that living truthfully is the greatest penance.
Cotton is plain and soft and hides nothing; so too the honest heart is simple, soft, and free of stain.
doha: honest like plain cotton
I dress in plain cotton and live simply; people tell me I'm too honest for business, but I wouldn't change.
cotton, honest living

Compose a doha that compares honest living to plain white cotton, which hides no dirt and wears no disguise, and say that such a life needs no penance because the lack of lies itself is the highest one.
touchstone, honest speech
My teacher put every claim we made to the test like a touchstone, and only honest answers survived; I want a doha for that kind of teacher.
doha pls: touchstone tests every word and only honest ones pass
On the touchstone of time, the false word wears away and the true one shines brighter.
Write a doha that says the sin of lying is exposed sooner or later just as a touchstone reveals what is real, and that a person who speaks honestly is never afraid of being tested by anyone.
On a long journey I met a fellow traveler who lied about everything, and I felt sorry for him; I'd like a doha on honest living, as wide as the ocean.
doha: traveler crossing the ocean needs honest words as his only guide
O traveler on the ocean of life, let honest speech be your compass; falsehood drowns every hope.
traveler, ocean, honesty
Write a doha for a traveler setting out across the ocean of the world, telling him that he should carry only honesty, since this alone is the penance that keeps him safe and his mind at peace.

A woman at the office was blamed for another's mistake and kept silent rather than lie; write a doha praising people who protect honesty even when it costs them, and calling falsehood the heaviest sin.
My teenage son confessed that he was the one who broke the window, and I was proud and a little teary; doha for him?
Dark deeds crumble in daylight; honest words stand firm in any weather.
honesty beyond penance
pls a doha on honest living, simple words
fly, lies, honesty
A fly landed on my table while my cousin was making up another excuse, and it struck me how persistent small lies are.
doha on lies being as annoying as a fly
Write a doha that likens a lie to a fly that keeps returning no matter how many times you drive it away, urging the listener to choose honest speech which leaves the mind clean and calm.
The fly of falsehood returns to every wound; keep the heart clean and nothing remains to settle on.
My neighbour, a moneylender, charges fair interest and never lies about the terms, and people say he is brave as a lion for it; doha idea?
Please write a doha about a moneylender who deals honestly and fears no one, standing fearless like a lion, to show that a person living in truth needs no other penance or protection.
doha: honest moneylender fearless like a lion
The lion fears no hunter's trick, the honest moneylender no ledger's page; both walk free.
lion, moneylender, honesty
Write a doha about a cleric who sits and sifts people's words with a winnowing fan, separating husk from grain, keeping only honest speech, because lying is the greatest sin in any faith.
doha pls: cleric w winnowing fan sifting lies out
cleric, winnowing fan, honesty
Sift your words with the winnowing fan, O cleric, until only the honest grain remains and the chaff of falsehood blows away.
Our local cleric always says that he'd rather lose a debate than tell one lie, and I have seen him sift every statement before speaking, like grain in a winnowing fan.
chakor bird, cloth sheet, honesty
doha w chakor bird and a plain cloth sheet about being honest
The chakor bird loves only its beloved, nothing else; spread your plain cloth sheet and love only the honest word.
My grandfather, poor and loyal as a chakor bird to his principles, slept on a plain cloth sheet and never told a lie, and I want a doha for him.
Write a doha about a poor man who owns nothing but a plain cloth sheet, yet like a chakor bird remains devoted to one thing alone: honest speech, which is the greatest wealth.
no sin like lying
I used to invent excuses for everything, but after a bad week I decided to say things as they are; I'd love a doha for that decision.
Honesty is a quiet strength; the liar's loud words fade before evening.
Write a doha that says the greatest penance of all is not hardship or fasting but the daily effort to stay honest in thought, word and deed, and that every lie is a sin that darkens the mind.
doha on honest living, keep it short n sweet
